issue_request: FHIR-47373 was Applied as Not Persuasive with Modification for R6. The commenter asked whether SubscriptionTopic notificationShape.relatedQuery inclusion was optional (MAY) or recommended (SHOULD), and the resolution clarified that support for the feature is optional while servers implementing it SHOULD include related queries when appropriate.
